invariants.rationale: Method returns result of postWrite; postWrite should return a non-null List<WriteStatus>.
Method expects a non-null preppedRecords input; operations depend on it.
instantTime is used in several method calls and passed to Option.ofNullable; precondition for correct write.
If no records are prepped, likely no WriteStatus are produced, though postWrite might still produce results, but at least one should be empty.
